product.title: Original eBike Tour - Best of Boulder - guided Bike Tour

description.text: Get a comprehensive tour of Boulder on this excursion astride an electric bike. Riding an e-bike means you can work as hard as you like, using the pedal assist to get you up the hills. Stops include Hotel Boulderado, Pearl Street Mall, The Boulder Dushanbe Teahouse, Boulder Creek Path, University of Colorado at Boulder, Folsom Field. Pedal through the charming neighborhoods, NCAR, University of Colorado, Chautauqua, the historic downtown areas, and along Boulder Creek. Ideal for visitors basing in Boulder who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
